definition.name: Build and retain five source-bound native products

steps.name: Install the existing pinned Python recipe dependencies
Check actual emitted phase graphs and exact type omissions
Build the normal managed-guest host profile and freeze exact products
steps.run:
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json, os, shutil, time, tomllib
from pathlib import Path
from tools.build_observation import build_environment
from tools.phase2_operator_process import require
from tools.phase3_resource_identity import file_identity, inventory, source_identity
from tools.rust_capsule_build import Commands
from tools.rust_capsule_project import fresh, write_json
root=Path.cwd();output=fresh(Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP'])/'sdk-native-products')
require(os.environ['C_THREAD_PROFILE_CONTROLS'] in ('true','false'),'native-products-c-profile-closed-selector')
require(os.environ['COMPILER_DIAGNOSTIC_CONTROLS'] in ('true','false'),'native-products-compiler-diagnostics-closed-selector')
require(not (os.environ['C_THREAD_PROFILE_CONTROLS']=='true' and os.environ['COMPILER_DIAGNOSTIC_CONTROLS']=='true'),
    'native-products-disjoint-finite-control-programmes')
pins=tomllib.loads((root/'rust-toolchain.toml').read_text())
require(pins['toolchain']['channel']=='1.97.1','native-products-original-rust-pin')
selected=('.github/workflows/sdk-native-products.yml','.cargo/managed-guest.toml',
    'tools/qualify_rust_capsules.py','tools/toolchain.toml','tools/rust_capsule_build.py',
    'tools/build_observation.py','tools/build_process.py','tools/build_process_linux.py')
def material_identities():
    result={p:file_identity(root/p) for p in selected}
    for directory, maximum_files, maximum_bytes in (
        ('wit',2048,8*1024**2),('schemas',256,4*1024**2),
        ('examples/echo-contract/wit',128,1024**2),('api/proto',128,1024**2)):
        observed=inventory(root/directory,maximum_files=maximum_files,
            maximum_bytes=maximum_bytes,deadline=time.monotonic()+30)
        for row in observed['files']:
            name=directory+'/'+row['path']
            require(name not in result,'native-products-material-duplicate')
            result[name]={'sha256':row['sha256'],'bytes':row['bytes']}
    return dict(sorted(result.items()))
before=source_identity(root);materials=material_identities()
write_json(output/'source-inputs.json',{'native':before,'materials':materials})
target=Path(os.environ.get('CARGO_TARGET_DIR',root/'target')).resolve()
environment=build_environment(output)
environment.update(CARGO_TARGET_DIR=str(target),RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN='1.97.1',CARGO_INCREMENTAL='0',
    CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG='0',CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG='0',
    CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG_ASSERTIONS='true',CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG_ASSERTIONS='true',
    CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_OVERFLOW_CHECKS='true',CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_OVERFLOW_CHECKS='true')
commands=Commands(root,output,environment,deadline_seconds=1320,command_seconds=1200)
compiler=commands.run('rust-version','rustc','--version').decode().strip()
require(compiler.startswith('rustc 1.97.1 ('),'native-products-rust-version')
if os.environ['COMPILER_DIAGNOSTIC_CONTROLS']=='true':
    import re
    parser=commands.run('compiler-diagnostic-wasm-tools-version','wasm-tools','--version').decode().strip()
    require(re.match(r'^wasm-tools 1\.254\.0(?:\s|$)',parser) is not None,
        'native-products-original-component-parser')
    commands.run('compiler-diagnostic-stack-parse','wasm-tools','parse',
        root/'crates/latent-wasmtime/tests/fixtures/compatibility_stack.wat',
        '-o',output/'compatibility-stack.wasm')
    require(0<(output/'compatibility-stack.wasm').stat().st_size<=65536,
        'native-products-fixed-stack-component-bound')
commands.run('normal-host-build','cargo','--config',root/'.cargo/managed-guest.toml',
    'build','--locked','-p','latent','-p','latentd','--bins','-p','latent-packaging',
    '--example','package','--example','capsule_contracts','-p','latent-policy','--example','capsule_authoring')
commands.run('closed-http-refusal-controls','cargo','--config',root/'.cargo/managed-guest.toml',
    'test','--locked','-p','latent-capabilities','--lib','broker::http::refusal::tests::',
    '--','--test-threads=1')
commands.run('neutral-resource-signing-controls','cargo','--config',root/'.cargo/managed-guest.toml',
    'test','--locked','-p','latent-policy','--example','capsule_authoring',
    'authoring::resource_neutral::tests::','--','--test-threads=1')
observer=commands.run('positive-timer-observer-controls','cargo','--config',root/'.cargo/managed-guest.toml',
    'test','--locked','-p','latent-wasmtime','--lib','host::runtime::positive_timer_observer::tests::',
    '--','--test-threads=1')
require(b'test result: ok. 8 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' in observer,
    'native-products-positive-timer-eight-controls')
nominal=commands.run('phase-nominal-type-owner-controls','cargo','--config',root/'.cargo/managed-guest.toml',
    'test','--locked','-p','latent-packaging','--lib','phase_nominal_owner_',
    '--','--test-threads=1')
require(b'test result: ok. 2 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' in nominal,
    'native-products-phase-nominal-two-controls')
descriptive=commands.run('descriptive-native-thread-proof-controls','cargo','--config',root/'.cargo/managed-guest.toml',
    'test','--locked','-p','latent-packaging','--lib','semantics::wasm::tests::canonical_creator_',
    '--','--test-threads=1')
require(b'test result: ok. 2 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' in descriptive,
    'native-products-descriptive-two-native-proof-controls')
emitted=commands.run('phase-emitted-type-owner-controls','cargo','--config',root/'.cargo/managed-guest.toml',
    'test','--locked','-p','latent-packaging','--lib',
    'phase_component_nominal_pruning_rejects_missing_or_changed_owned_types','--','--test-threads=1')
require(b'test result: ok. 1 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' in emitted,
    'native-products-phase-emitted-one-control')
tenant_config=commands.run('independent-http-configuration-controls','cargo','--config',root/'.cargo/managed-guest.toml',
    'test','--locked','-p','latentd','--lib','config::tests::providers::http_streaming::',
    '--','--test-threads=1')
require(b'test result: ok. 8 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' in tenant_config,
    'native-products-independent-http-eight-configuration-controls')
tenant_dispatch=commands.run('independent-http-dispatch-controls','cargo','--config',root/'.cargo/managed-guest.toml',
    'test','--locked','-p','latentd','--lib','standalone::providers::runtime::http::streaming::tests::',
    '--','--test-threads=1')
require(b'test result: ok. 2 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' in tenant_dispatch,
    'native-products-independent-http-two-dispatch-controls')
tenant_secrets=commands.run('independent-http-secret-controls','cargo','--config',root/'.cargo/managed-guest.toml',
    'test','--locked','-p','latent-http','--lib',
    'tests::secret_references::separate_http_installation_cannot_rebind_foreign_tenant_provider_or_origin_credentials',
    '--','--test-threads=1')
require(b'test result: ok. 1 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' in tenant_secrets,
    'native-products-independent-http-one-secret-control')
operational_metadata=commands.run('phase-operational-metadata-controls','cargo','--config',root/'.cargo/managed-guest.toml',
    'test','--locked','-p','latent-packaging','--test','host_abi',
    'phase_nominal_owner_metadata_requires_only_operational_source_bindings',
    '--','--exact','--test-threads=1')
require(b'test result: ok. 1 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' in operational_metadata,
    'native-products-phase-operational-one-metadata-control')
operational_binding=commands.run('phase-operational-binding-controls','cargo','--config',root/'.cargo/managed-guest.toml',
    'test','--locked','-p','latent-control-store','--lib',
    'deployments::tests::bindings::phase_nominal::phase_nominal_owner_compiles_without_legacy_authority_but_phase_and_callable_imports_remain_required',
    '--','--exact','--test-threads=1')
require(b'test result: ok. 1 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' in operational_binding,
    'native-products-phase-operational-one-binding-control')
protocol_reader=commands.run('release-preparation-protocol-reader-controls','python3','-B','-c',
    'import sys,unittest\n'
    'suite=unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromName("tools.tests.test_sdk_native_products_reader")\n'
    'result=unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=sys.stdout,verbosity=2).run(suite)\n'
    'sys.exit(0 if result.wasSuccessful() and not result.skipped else 1)')
require(b'Ran 12 tests' in protocol_reader and b'OK' in protocol_reader,
    'native-products-protocol-reader-twelve-controls')
release_deadline=commands.run('release-preparation-deadline-controls','cargo','--config',root/'.cargo/managed-guest.toml',
    'test','--locked','-p','latent-wire','--lib','management::release::preparation::tests::',
    '--','--test-threads=1')
require(b'test result: ok. 2 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' in release_deadline,
    'native-products-release-preparation-two-deadline-controls')
web_readiness=commands.run('release-preparation-web-readiness-controls','cargo','--config',root/'.cargo/managed-guest.toml',
    'test','--locked','-p','latent-wire','--lib','management::release::web::preparation::tests::',
    '--','--test-threads=1')
require(b'test result: ok. 4 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' in web_readiness,
    'native-products-original-web-four-readiness-controls')
release_rpc=commands.run('release-preparation-rpc-controls','cargo','--config',root/'.cargo/managed-guest.toml',
    'test','--locked','-p','latent-wire','--test','management_service','release::preparation::',
    '--','--test-threads=1')
require(b'test result: ok. 6 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' in release_rpc,
    'native-products-release-preparation-six-scoped-rpc-controls')
release_cli=commands.run('release-preparation-cli-controls','cargo','--config',root/'.cargo/managed-guest.toml',
    'test','--locked','-p','latent','--lib',
    'management::tests::preparation::release_prepare_requires_exact_publication_generation_and_finite_setup_wait',
    '--','--exact','--test-threads=1')
require(b'test result: ok. 1 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' in release_cli,
    'native-products-release-preparation-one-cli-control')
release_projection=commands.run('release-preparation-projection-controls','cargo','--config',root/'.cargo/managed-guest.toml',
    'test','--locked','-p','latent','--lib',
    'management::phase2::execute::release::tests::prepared_release_projection_is_bounded_lossless_and_never_execution_authority',
    '--','--exact','--test-threads=1')
require(b'test result: ok. 1 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' in release_projection,
    'native-products-release-preparation-one-projection-control')
release_transport=commands.run('release-preparation-transport-controls','cargo','--config',root/'.cargo/managed-guest.toml',
    'test','--locked','-p','latentd','--lib','standalone::transport::tests::web_preparation::',
    '--','--test-threads=1')
require(b'test result: ok. 4 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' in release_transport,
    'native-products-release-preparation-four-transport-controls')
release_command_name=commands.run('release-preparation-command-name-controls','cargo','--config',root/'.cargo/managed-guest.toml',
    'test','--locked','-p','latent','--lib',
    'command::tests::exact_release_preparation_command_keeps_its_public_result_name',
    '--','--exact','--test-threads=1')
require(b'test result: ok. 1 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' in release_command_name,
    'native-products-release-preparation-one-command-name-control')
release_dispatch=commands.run('release-preparation-dispatch-controls','cargo','--config',root/'.cargo/managed-guest.toml',
    'test','--locked','-p','latent','--lib',
    'management::execute::tests::parsed_release_prepare_keeps_management_dispatch_and_exact_selection',
    '--','--exact','--test-threads=1')
require(b'test result: ok. 1 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' in release_dispatch,
    'native-products-release-preparation-one-dispatch-control')
if os.environ['C_THREAD_PROFILE_CONTROLS']=='true':
    result=commands.run('c-original-and-final-proof-controls','cargo','--config',root/'.cargo/managed-guest.toml','test','--locked','-p','latent-component-threading','--lib','--','--test-threads=1')
    require(b'test result: ok. 60 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' in result,'c-original-and-final-proof-controls-exact-count')
    result=commands.run('c-profile-1','cargo','--config',root/'.cargo/managed-guest.toml','test','--locked','-p','latent-wasmtime','--lib','cache::tests::c_verification_work_is_admitted_before_use_and_never_becomes_resident_source','--','--exact','--test-threads=1')
    require(b'test result: ok. 1 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' in result,'c-profile-1-exact-count')
    result=commands.run('c-profile-2','cargo','--config',root/'.cargo/managed-guest.toml','test','--locked','-p','latent-wasmtime','--lib','component_threading::tests::c_profile_requires_prepaid_work_before_reading_proof_and_never_grants_from_data','--','--exact','--test-threads=1')
    require(b'test result: ok. 1 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' in result,'c-profile-2-exact-count')
    result=commands.run('c-profile-3','cargo','--config',root/'.cargo/managed-guest.toml','test','--locked','-p','latent-wasmtime','--lib','component_threading::tests::c_profile_proof_cannot_replay_as_rust_or_under_default_cache_settings','--','--exact','--test-threads=1')
    require(b'test result: ok. 1 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' in result,'c-profile-3-exact-count')
    result=commands.run('c-profile-4','cargo','--config',root/'.cargo/managed-guest.toml','test','--locked','-p','latent-wasmtime','--lib','config::engine::tests::c_bootstrap_changes_only_the_explicit_closed_native_profile_field','--','--exact','--test-threads=1')
    require(b'test result: ok. 1 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' in result,'c-profile-4-exact-count')
    result=commands.run('c-profile-5','cargo','--config',root/'.cargo/managed-guest.toml','test','--locked','-p','latent-wasmtime','--lib','aot::ownership::tests::recomputed_input_work_shares_the_original_aggregate_and_refunds_after_owner_drop','--','--exact','--test-threads=1')
    require(b'test result: ok. 1 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' in result,'c-profile-5-exact-count')
    result=commands.run('c-profile-6','cargo','--config',root/'.cargo/managed-guest.toml','test','--locked','-p','latent-manifest','--lib','runtime_compatibility::tests::cooperative_c_is_a_distinct_trusted_profile_and_default_fingerprint_is_stable','--','--exact','--test-threads=1')
    require(b'test result: ok. 1 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' in result,'c-profile-6-exact-count')
    result=commands.run('c-profile-7','cargo','--config',root/'.cargo/managed-guest.toml','test','--locked','-p','latentd','--lib','config::tests::engine::c_threading_engine_input_is_closed_and_default_input_remains_unselected','--','--exact','--test-threads=1')
    require(b'test result: ok. 1 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' in result,'c-profile-7-exact-count')
    result=commands.run('c-profile-8','cargo','--config',root/'.cargo/managed-guest.toml','test','--locked','-p','latentd','--lib','config::tests::engine::activation_stack_accounting_is_a_closed_opt_in_and_omission_stays_default','--','--exact','--test-threads=1')
    require(b'test result: ok. 1 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' in result,'c-profile-8-exact-count')
    result=commands.run('c-profile-9','cargo','--config',root/'.cargo/managed-guest.toml','test','--locked','-p','latentd','--lib','config::tests::providers::activation_runtime::c_native_opt_in_preserves_the_old_provider_digest_and_requires_its_own_binding','--','--exact','--test-threads=1')
    require(b'test result: ok. 1 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' in result,'c-profile-9-exact-count')
    result=commands.run('c-profile-10','cargo','--config',root/'.cargo/managed-guest.toml','test','--locked','-p','latentd','--lib','config::tests::providers::activation_runtime::protected_c_profile_reaches_normal_node_settings_without_raising_any_limits','--','--exact','--test-threads=1')
    require(b'test result: ok. 1 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' in result,'c-profile-10-exact-count')
    result=commands.run('c-profile-11','cargo','--config',root/'.cargo/managed-guest.toml','test','--locked','-p','latentd','--lib','config::tests::providers::activation_runtime::activation_owned_stack_selection_keeps_native_threads_and_provider_quotas_unchanged','--','--exact','--test-threads=1')
    require(b'test result: ok. 1 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' in result,'c-profile-11-exact-count')
workers=commands.run('ordinary-async-worker-owner-controls','cargo','--config',root/'.cargo/managed-guest.toml',
    'test','--locked','-p','latent-wasmtime','--lib','native_stacks::tests::',
    '--','--test-threads=1')
require(b'test result: ok. 11 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' in workers,
    'native-products-ordinary-async-eleven-owner-controls')
if os.environ['COMPILER_DIAGNOSTIC_CONTROLS']=='true':
    require(b'native_stacks::tests::child_total_start_capacity_survives_logical_completion_and_releases_only_after_store_drop ... ok' in workers,
        'native-products-actual-total-start-retirement-control')
    for label, package, name in (
        ('compiler-diagnostic-owner-buckets','latent-core','activation_runtime::tests::actual_owner_refusals_name_only_the_original_bucket_without_refunding_live_owners'),
        ('compiler-diagnostic-native-memory','latent-core','activation_runtime::tests::actual_native_reservation_refusal_keeps_original_budget_and_does_not_guess_other_dimensions'),
        ('compiler-diagnostic-engine-stack','latent-wasmtime','containment::tests::only_the_actual_engine_stack_overflow_produces_stack_exhaustion_diagnostic')):
        actual=commands.run(label,'cargo','--config',root/'.cargo/managed-guest.toml',
            'test','--locked','-p',package,'--lib',name,'--','--exact','--test-threads=1')
        require(b'test result: ok. 1 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' in actual
            and ('test '+name+' ... ok').encode() in actual,
            'native-products-actual-resource-control-no-skip')
    commands.environment['LSF_COMPATIBILITY_STACK_COMPONENT']=str(output/'compatibility-stack.wasm')
    stack=commands.run('compiler-diagnostic-actual-stack-component','cargo','--config',root/'.cargo/managed-guest.toml',
        'test','--locked','-p','latent-wasmtime','--test','compatibility_stack',
        'compatibility_stack::actual_stack_overflow_keeps_original_typed_fact_and_new_store_fresh_result',
        '--','--ignored','--exact','--nocapture','--test-threads=1')
    require(b'test result: ok. 1 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' in stack
        and b'LSF_COMPATIBILITY_STACK_V1 stack-reason=26 fresh=42 stores=2 signed-language=false' in stack,
        'native-products-actual-stack-component-and-fresh-store')
require(before==source_identity(root) and materials==material_identities(),
    'native-products-source-changed')
products={};owned=output/'native-binaries';owned.mkdir(mode=0o700)
for name in ('latent','latentd','examples/package','examples/capsule_contracts','examples/capsule_authoring'):
    source=target/'debug'/name;identity=file_identity(source,512*1024**2)
    destination=owned/name.replace('/','-');shutil.copyfile(source,destination);destination.chmod(0o700)
    require(file_identity(source,512*1024**2)==identity==file_identity(destination,512*1024**2),
        'native-products-capture-changed')
    products[name]=identity
write_json(output/'native-products.json',{'schemaVersion':'latent.sdk.native-products.v1',
    'status':'built','sourceRevision':os.environ['GITHUB_SHA'],'source':before,'materials':materials,
    'compiler':compiler,'products':products,'commands':commands.records,
    'profile':'normal-managed-guest-default-features','signedQualification':False,
    'guestComponentsCompiled':False,'historicalReceiptRewritten':False})
PY

steps.name: Retain source-bound products and bounded build failures

reviewReason: Reviewed mandatory29-stage compiler diagnostic programme retains all23 original commands, quotas and product identities; new exact operation controls and canonical WAT shared-engine stack/fresh test are selected only by the closed default-false input.
